purpose: Post-result portability regression, no historical outcomes changed
execution_order: Full solver-noise suite followed by ordinary full suite, sequentially

noise_scope.method: nextafter toward positive infinity for finite nonzero real and imaginary components of solver output, before downstream arithmetic

comparison_rules.exact: Operational verdicts, terminal/convergence/futility/rounding flags, structure, integer fields and cost
comparison_rules.numeric: Stable floating diagnostics retain conditioned absolute and relative bounds
comparison_rules.diagnostic_only: antecedent_ratio when previous_difference <= recorded rounding; shadow_C2_converging remains a non-operational diagnostic flag

diagnostics_command: OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 python3 -c "from attention.audit_a006_portability import library_audit; from attention.io import read_json,write_json; write_json('binding/results/B002/step0/diagnostics.json',{name:library_audit(read_json('attention/sample_library_'+name+'.json')) for name in ('a006','a007')})"
